name: normattiva-mcp
description: MCP server wrapping the Normattiva OpenData API for Italian legislation (search, read articles, monitor recent updates).

scripts.bundle: ./node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.bundled.mjs --external:zod --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/* && mv dist/index.bundled.mjs dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run bundle && cp ../../README.md ../../LICENSE .
scripts.postpack: rm README.md LICENSE && npm run build

author: adellorto (https://github.com/adellorto)
